To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dynamical system theory of continuous maps on a compact metric space X can be extended to continuous maps on the Vietoris space VX and the upper space UX, that the upper space UX is a continuous dcpo and that the space of Borel probabilities PUX on UX is a dcpo and can be given a computable structure.
dynamical systems, fractals and measures can be computed using domain theory.

(1) the Vietoris and upper space functors can be used to compute the attractors of dynamical systems; (2) the Vietoris functor can be used to obtain the Julia set of a rational map; (3) the probabilistic power functor can be used effectively to compute the invariant measure of a hyperbolic itered function system with probabilities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of dynamical systems and fractals from a domain theoretic perspective.
the computation of dynamial systems, fractals and measures via domain theory and category theory.
a new approach to the computation of dynamial systems, fractals and measures.

dynamical systems, measures and fractals can be computed effectively in a domain theoretic setting.
the theory of domain theory is the right tool for computing dynamical systems, measures, and fractals.
